items.title: Ron Carter interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999
items.q: When you were with Miles... everyone in that band was a young man... Tony Williams was younger

ctx.x: Eric and I — Eric Dolphy and I stayed in New York, and Chico disbanded, and Chico and the band went to California. The guitar player now is one of the oldest studio guys and the cello player is probably retired, he’s probably close to 85 by now, so the band disbanded.

When you were with Miles, I was just looking at some dates today, and I guess I didn’t quite realize that you were, everyone in that band was a young man, you were 26 or something like that, and of course Tony Williams was younger and Herbie was about—
